performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (1) 📘 Rule violations (0) 📜 Skill insights (0)
1. Explicit OPTIONS enablement broken 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness
>
>Description >
> >
>When provide_automatic_options=True is supplied directly or through a view attribute, the new
>None guard skips adding OPTIONS to the rule's methods. Routing therefore rejects OPTIONS with
>405 before Flask can generate the promised automatic response.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[src/flask/sansio/app.py[R638-641]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/pull/6235/files#diff-c57b8f34cffef9948b35aec94cb2364f75c1a2854064a13bf8216603cb1f607bR638-R641) > >```diff >+ if provide_automatic_options is None: >+ if "OPTIONS" not in methods and self.config["PROVIDE_AUTOMATIC_OPTIONS"]: >+ provide_automatic_options = True >+ required_methods.add("OPTIONS") >``` >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>The public contract says this parameter adds OPTIONS and handles it automatically, but the changed
>branch adds OPTIONS only while resolving a None value. The resulting rule can have its automatic
>flag set to true without accepting OPTIONS, and dispatch raises any routing exception before
>checking that flag; class-based views also propagate explicit values through the same path.
>
> > [src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py[408-437]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/56a0ec00080153af0afed3b70b36ab9530869108/src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py/#L408-L437) > [src/flask/sansio/app.py[633-649]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/56a0ec00080153af0afed3b70b36ab9530869108/src/flask/sansio/app.py/#L633-L649) > [src/flask/app.py[981-990]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/56a0ec00080153af0afed3b70b36ab9530869108/src/flask/app.py/#L981-L990) > [src/flask/views.py[124-135]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/56a0ec00080153af0afed3b70b36ab9530869108/src/flask/views.py/#L124-L135) >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Explicitly setting `provide_automatic_options=True` no longer adds `OPTIONS` to the URL rule. The request consequently fails routing with 405 before automatic OPTIONS dispatch can occur. > >## Issue Context >Configuration should determine the value only when no explicit value or view attribute is provided. After resolving that value, `OPTIONS` must be added whenever the final value is true. Add regression coverage for both an explicit argument and a view function or class-based view attribute set to true. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/flask/sansio/app.py[633-649] >- tests/test_basic.py[75-127] >- tests/test_views.py[101-117] >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
